reason: I live abroad and they only ship within Georgia, so I'd have to get someone to bring it over. On top of that we haven't played a board game in over a year, so it would most likely just sit on the shelf.
objection: I'm not sure I could come up with a toast in 30 seconds, especially in Georgian with words like 'hypotenuse' in it. I'd be embarrassed in front of friends, and the game would fizzle out after one evening.
would_change_my_mind: International shipping, or a set I could order to my country as a gift for a supra with the diaspora crowd, plus a short video showing that it's fun even if you can't make toasts.
